scope: Independent of chat-host and compound/native-control authors; reviewer authored spatial helper, which is excluded from this independent review.
checks: Host-only chat dispatch retains allow-tools and consultation gates before requests and after real native confirmation.
New chat mutations keep fresh manual confirmation and actual host/session generation, session content, hierarchy, queues and candidate binding snapshots.
Managed child lifecycle is refused for direct child close/rename; parent close retains native destructive scope and child recursion.
Mounted-host send validates actual mounted Control/tree/composer parent and existing conversation/candidate/Issue binding before ordinary send.
Compound declarations select only advertised supported native descendant actions and recheck protected/page-only ancestors; no arbitrary method/signal dispatcher was added.

MenuBar, Tree cell and RichText metadata actions re-resolve actual target identity/state after confirmation and return native delivery plus actual readback, without claiming downstream business completion.

CodeBuddy read-only sessions advertise only host-mediated Read and the exact reserved read-only host facade. Native Glob/Grep are disabled. Host read_file/read_script/list_directory use bounded validated arguments; write callbacks, real shell commands, nested delegation and production host actions remain denied.

Final host-command correction reread: mounted host_instance accepts only finite interoperable integers, schedule titles are stripped before native LineEdit assignment, and history/change-view actions fail unless the actual native dialog is visible.
Final PNG header reader reread: failed begin-read or PNG_IMAGE_FAILED rejects dimensions and frees native header state before returning; no decoded pixels are allocated by the dimension query.

corrected_findings.finding: Hashing unvalidated declaration extras could invoke Object string conversion during preview.
corrected_findings.verified_correction: Declaration hash uses validated aliases containing only bounded strings and child identity.

corrected_findings.finding: item_edited callbacks can free the Tree before subsequent native accessibility work.
corrected_findings.verified_correction: ObjectDB identity is rechecked after item_edited and custom_item_clicked signals.

corrected_findings.finding: Absent declaration metadata generated repeated engine errors during ordinary discovery.
corrected_findings.verified_correction: has_meta guard returns before reading absent declaration data.

corrected_findings.finding: Compressed-image bytes were decoded before the chat pixel/dimension limits were checked.
corrected_findings.verified_correction: The same bounded immutable byte buffer is first inspected by native PNG begin-read/header+free, TurboJPEG decompress-header+destroy, or WebPGetInfo. Width/height positivity, <=8192 bounds and <=32MP product are checked before full pixel decode. The post-decode bounds remain. This verification is source-level; runtime allocation tests belong to the chat runner.

limitations: Static independent review is not a claim of all-window runtime, OS/native-window, pixel, focus/IME or hardware validation.
Provider CodeBuddy execution and real account authentication were not run by this reviewer; callback restrictions and current tool binding were read from source.
Chat lifecycle and compound native runtime reports belong to their actual runners and are not substituted by this static review.
No production application, project, conversation owner, binding, queue or history was changed by this reviewer.
